feature: Return unsynced subcontractor invoices to Draft for editing

flows.name: Return an unsynced invoice under review to Draft
steps: Open APP-01 while its status is Under Review and all accounting sync markers are empty
Choose Return to Draft & Edit from the Actions menu
Refresh the canonical invoice and open the Summary editor
flows.expectedOutcome: APP-01 becomes Draft and its existing Summary and SOV editors are available

flows.name: Protect accounting-owned and terminal invoices
steps: Attempt the reverse transition with an accounting sync marker
Attempt an arbitrary workflow transition or mixed field edit
Attempt a stale write after the invoice status or sync state changes
flows.expectedOutcome: Every protected or stale mutation is rejected with a specific conflict

flows.name: Preserve authenticated editing and audit attribution
steps: Exercise an existing Draft invoice edit as an authorized invoice contact
Read back the status audit actor and guarded line-item behavior
flows.expectedOutcome: Existing Draft editing remains valid while manager workflow actions and audit attribution are enforced at the database boundary

claims.description: An authorized manager can return an unsynced under-review invoice to Draft and enter its existing editor
Accounting-linked, stale, and invalid workflow mutations fail closed
Existing Draft editing remains supported and workflow audit attribution is transactional
